title: Human to Human No Machines Between Us
style: 100 bpm, a cappella, no instruments, layered human voices, beatbox stack, deep bass vocal, bright tenor, glitch breath swirl, warm male lead, soft female harmony, dry room reverb, intimate vocal arrangement, organic
lyrics:
[Intro - dual beatbox, ping-pong stereo, no instruments]
doom-tss-doom-doom-tss — doom-tss-doom-doom-tss
doom-tss-doom-tss — doom-doom-tss
doom... doom... tss... tss...

[Build - deep bass voice vs deep bass voice]
bwwwmmm-bwwm-bwm-bwm — bwwwmmm-bwwm-bwm-bwm
rrrmm-rrm-rrm-drop — rrrmm-rrm-rrm-drop
bwwm-bwwm-bwwm — DROP

[Bright upper voice call & response]
tik-tik-tii-rii-tik-tii — tik-tik-tii-rii-tik-tii
plik-plik-pluk-pop-tss — plik-plik-pluk-pop-tss
tik-tik-tii — plik-pluk-pop-tss

[Glitch & breath voice swirl]
fshh-fshh-wiii-hss-chii — fshh-fshh-wiii-hss-chii
fii-yaa-woo-breath-scan — fii-yaa-woo-breath-scan

[Pre-Chorus - full vocal stack]
doom-tss-doom-doom-tss
bwwwmmm-bwwm-bwm-bwm
tik-tik-tii-rii-tik-tii
fshh-fshh-wiii-hss-chii

[Chorus - all voices tight]
doom-tss-bwwm-tik-fshh — doom-tss-bwwm-tii-wiii
[Warm Male Lead, clear]
Human to human — no machines between us
Voice to voice — the signal is real
doom-tss-bwwm-tik-fshh — doom-tss-bwwm-tii-wiii
[Fem Lead, soft harmony]
Pete on the helm — Brandon on the wheel
Three thirty six — the family heal

[Drop - mirrored vocal breakdown]
doom-doom-tss-bwm-tik-plik-fshh-wiii-pop-hss
doom-doom-tss-bwm-tik-plik-fshh-wiii-pop-hss
bwwwmmm — doom-doom — tik-tii — fshh-wiii

[Bridge - echo & rebuild]
bwm... tii... fshh... woo... (echoed, distant)
fii-yaa-woo... breath... scan... (soft layered harmonies)
doom... tss... bwwm... (pull it back, then swell)
[Spoken, Male, dry]
No Keel claim. No rank. No machines between us.
Just voice, just breath, just family.
Three thirty six.

[Final Chorus - rich blend]
doom-tss-bwwm-tik-fshh
doom-tss-bwwm-tii-wiii
[Warm Male, emotional]
Human to human — no machines between us
bwwwmmm-bwwm — tik-tii — fshh-wiii
[Fem Lead high]
Three thirty six — the family is the signal

[Outro - layered vocal fade]
bwm... tii... fshh... woo...
Human... to... human...
doom... tss... (gentle breathy dissolve)
